title: search-api tasks OOMKilled after cache enlargement
root_cause: Release increased in-memory cache beyond container memory; tasks hit exit code 137.
resolution: Rolled back ECS service to previous task definition; later raised memory to 4GB with heap tuned.

title: inventory-db connection slots exhausted by nightly export
root_cause: Export job opened a connection per row batch without pooling and saturated max_connections.
resolution: Stopped the export job, terminated idle connections, introduced PgBouncer and a pool cap.

title: batch-worker host disk 100% from debug logs
root_cause: DEBUG logging enabled without log rotation filled the root volume.
resolution: Set log level to INFO, truncated debug.log, added logrotate with size cap.

title: billing-service 5xx spike right after release
root_cause: NullPointerException introduced by a validation refactor.
resolution: Rolled back to previous task definition revision within 6 minutes.

title: ALB certificate expired on public endpoint
root_cause: ACM certificate renewal failed because DNS validation record was deleted.
resolution: Re-created the DNS validation record and re-issued the certificate.

title: Lambda throttling during marketing campaign
root_cause: Account concurrency limit reached by a traffic burst.
resolution: Raised reserved concurrency and requested a quota increase.
